name: Midas mAPOLLO
oneLiner: mAPOLLO is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping an Apollo Crypto managed strategy; permissioned mint/redeem, not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: Apollo Crypto managed yield strategy tracked through a Midas liquid-yield token.
pegMechanism: Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token with primary mint/redeem through Midas rails; it does not maintain a fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mAPOLLO is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

params.assetLabel: Apollo Crypto managed yield strategy NAV

notices.title: Not the Apollo credit fund
notices.message: mAPOLLO is a Midas / Apollo Crypto liquid-yield token and is distinct from ACRED or ACRDX private-credit fund shares.

mintAuthority.summary: mAPOLLO is a Midas liquid-yield token minted through role-gated DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts: only addresses with the Midas MINT_OPERATOR role (managed by MidasAccessControl) can mint, deposits/redemptions are greenlist-gated, and the upgradeable contracts use an off-chain NAV conversion rate.

controls.label: Midas mint operator (role-gated mint)
controls.evidence: Midas tokens can only be minted/burned by addresses holding the MINT/BURN_OPERATOR role granted through MidasAccessControl; the DepositVault mints mTokens against greenlisted deposits at an off-chain conversion rate, with admin-set mint/redeem limits.

controls.label: Midas DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (MidasAccessControl)
controls.evidence: Midas DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grants/revokes the mint/burn/pause/greenlist/blacklist operator roles and can change the price aggregator; Midas docs acknowledge management roles create a centralized, trust-based system over upgradeable contracts.

review.evidence: Midas smart-contract architecture (audited) uses MidasAccessControl with role-gated MINT_OPERATOR minting via DepositVault, greenlist/blacklist access control, off-chain conversion pricing, and upgradeable contracts; mAPOLLO follows the same Midas mToken pattern. This is a role-gated permissioned mint, refining the issuer-direct-mint lead.
review.sourceFreeRationale: mAPOLLO-specific on-chain MidasAccessControl/DepositVault addresses and the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (EOA/multisig) were not read live in this pass; classification rests on the documented Midas mToken role architecture.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the mAPOLLO DepositVault/RedemptionVault and MidasAccessControl addresses and the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE / mint-operator holders on Ethereum, and whether admin is a Safe/multisig.
